core_themes.name: Modern languages as interdisciplinary academic subject
core_themes.claim: The study of a modern language is an interdisciplinary subject offering the same cognitive and academic advantages as other humanities disciplines.

core_themes.name: Transferable skills benefit
core_themes.claim: AS and A level language study fosters transferable skills such as communication, critical thinking, autonomy, resourcefulness, creativity and cognitive flexibility that are valuable to the individual, society, higher education and employers.

core_themes.name: Universal relevance of content
core_themes.claim: The content is designed to be relevant to students of all disciplines, whether or not they progress to further study, while also providing a robust foundation for degree-level study.

core_themes.name: Core linguistic and intercultural skill requirements
core_themes.claim: AS and A level specifications must enable students to develop a defined set of linguistic, intercultural and transferable skills, including accurate language use, interaction with speakers, critical engagement with texts, and cross-cultural mediation.

core_themes.name: Thematic and cultural content structure
core_themes.claim: Specifications must require students to study specified numbers of themes drawn from defined areas of interest (social issues and trends; political/intellectual/artistic culture), built on GCSE content and using authentic spoken and written sources.

core_themes.name: Language skill development mechanisms
core_themes.claim: Specifications must require students to develop language knowledge and skills through specific activities such as listening, reading, summarising, translating and using language spontaneously across a range of authentic contexts.

core_themes.name: Literary and film work study requirements
core_themes.claim: Specifications must require study of one prescribed work at AS and two at A level (literary works and/or films), with critical response requirements that increase in depth and analytical demand at A level.

core_themes.name: A-level specific enhancements including research skills
core_themes.claim: A level specifications must additionally require more advanced critical/analytical thinking and independent research skills conducted in the language of study.

core_themes.name: Grammar specification requirements
core_themes.claim: Specifications must include detailed, prescribed grammar content lists for French, German and Spanish, with other languages required to include appendices of comparable challenge and breadth.

core_themes.name: Chinese-specific adaptations
core_themes.claim: The expectations for Chinese differ from other languages, with exceptions allowing English-language questions and responses in comprehension tasks while still requiring language-of-study responses for literary/film work.

implementation.note: The implementation aspect comprises a large package of distinct but interlocking requirements, ranging from skills frameworks to highly detailed grammar annexes, reflecting the document's function as a detailed specification rather than a single line of argument.
